neighbours.label: words for ending or terminating a process (logout, shutting down, fails, deleted, exit)
fire: The client should handle logout and clear the session token.
Returns True if the server is shutting down right now.
When the backup drive fails, the whole cluster slows down.
Old messages are deleted automatically after thirty days.
Press the Exit button to close the program safely.
The app crashes whenever the user tries to logout twice.
Most stores are shutting their doors early this week.
Once the record is deleted, it cannot be recovered.
quiet: The client should handle login and store the session token.
Returns True if the server is starting up right now.
When the backup drive works, the whole cluster runs fine.
Old messages are archived automatically after thirty days.
Press the Start button to open the program safely.
The app opens whenever the user tries to login twice.
Most stores are opening their doors early this week.
Once the record is saved, it can be shared.

notes: Card: ' deleted' x3, ' shutting' x2, 'Exit' x2, ' logout', ' fails', apoptosis. The - pole also has terminal states (discarded, evacuated, absent).
